name: Askshelf – WooCommerce AI Analytics, Sales & Profit Reports
author: nikhilbadveli6

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins › Add New, search for “Askshelf” and click Install Now, then Activate. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open Askshelf in the admin menu, just below WooCommerce. The free store snapshot is there straight away.
  3. Click Start free to connect, with no account or card, then ask your first question.
  4. Optional: for profit and margin, turn on Cost of Goods Sold in WooCommerce › Settings › Advanced › Features and add a cost to your products.
sections.faq:
What is Askshelf?

An AI reporting assistant for WooCommerce. You ask questions about your store in everyday language, and it looks up the answer in your WooCommerce Analytics data and explains it, with a chart where one helps.

Is Askshelf free?

Yes. The plugin is free, and every feature in it works on every plan. The store snapshot, the Dashboard widget and the weekly email never use questions. Answering questions uses the Askshelf service, and the free plan includes 10 questions per store each calendar month (UTC), with no account. Every question counts, including ones Askshelf declines as off-topic. Stopped questions, errors and questions blocked for personal data don’t.

Paid plans include more questions each month; see https://askshelf.in/#pricing. Buy, change or cancel one from Plans in the Askshelf top bar. Checkout and billing are by Dodo Payments; the plugin never takes payment details.

Do I need an OpenAI or other AI API key?

No. The Askshelf service handles the AI, so questions work as soon as you click Start free.

Where do I find it after installing?

In the Askshelf menu of your WordPress admin, just below WooCommerce. Click Start free to connect, then ask your first question. The store snapshot also appears on the WordPress Dashboard.

Does Askshelf change my store?

No. Every lookup is read-only, and there is no code in the plugin that writes store data. The only things it saves are its own settings and your chat history.

Is my customer data sent to the AI?

No. Customer names, emails, phone numbers and addresses are never read or sent. Questions that contain an email address or phone number are refused in your browser. Only your question and the totals needed to answer it (for example product names, order counts and amounts) are sent. See “External services” below for the full list.

How is this different from the WooCommerce Analytics reports?

It reads the same data, so the numbers match. Instead of picking a report, setting dates and filters and comparing tables yourself, you ask the question and get the answer, the change and a chart. It also covers things the built-in reports don’t put in one place, such as profit per product, products about to run out and stock that isn’t selling.

Do I need WooCommerce Analytics turned on?

Yes. Askshelf reads the Analytics tables. If Analytics is turned off, the Askshelf page explains how to turn it on.

Some numbers look low.

If Analytics hasn’t finished importing your older orders, the first screen shows a warning. Import them in Analytics › Settings.

Which order statuses does it count?

The same ones as WooCommerce Analytics. Change them in Analytics › Settings › Excluded statuses, and Askshelf follows.

How do I get profit and margin?

Turn on Cost of Goods Sold in WooCommerce › Settings › Advanced › Features, then add a cost to each product. WooCommerce records costs on orders placed after that, and Askshelf reports gross profit and margin from them.

Can I export the answers?

Yes. Answers with a chart or table have a Download CSV button.

What if no built-in lookup answers my question?

Turn on Custom queries in Askshelf settings (off by default). The AI can then write a read-only database query for the question. You see each query and choose whether to run it, and it can never read customer names, emails, phone numbers or addresses.

Is Askshelf GDPR friendly?

Askshelf is built to keep personal data out of the AI: customer names, emails, phone numbers and addresses are never read or sent, and the service does not keep your questions or answers. Review “External services” below and your own privacy policy before you use it on a live store.

Does it slow down my store?

No. Nothing runs on your shop’s pages. Lookups run only in the admin when someone asks a question, and the snapshot is cached for a few minutes.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. It works with HPOS (order tables) and the older posts storage.

The weekly email says WordPress could not send it.

The weekly email is sent by your own site with WordPress’s built-in mail, so it needs a site that can send email. Some hosts do not provide this. If “Send one now” fails, install an SMTP plugin (for example WP Mail SMTP or FluentSMTP) and connect it to your email provider, then try again. The message shows the reason WordPress gave.

Does deleting the plugin cancel my paid plan?

No. Cancel it first from Plans › “Invoices, card and cancelling” in the Askshelf top bar. If you reinstall on the same site and click Start free, your plan comes back.

Who can use it?

Anyone with the “View WooCommerce reports” capability (store managers and administrators by default). Connecting, changing what Askshelf may read and the weekly email need “Manage WooCommerce”.
sections.changelog:
0.4.2

  • Change: the plugin is now called “Askshelf – WooCommerce AI Analytics, Sales & Profit Reports” in the Plugins list. Nothing moves: the Askshelf menu, settings and saved questions stay where they are.
  • Change: a clearer WordPress.org page, with new screenshots, installation steps, more FAQs and a Live Preview of a sample store.

0.4.1

  • Fix: the Settings entry in the Askshelf menu now opens the settings dialog.
  • Fix: the live demo now opens on the Askshelf menu page instead of the old Analytics address.

0.4.0

  • New: Askshelf now has its own menu in the WordPress admin, below WooCommerce, with Ask and Settings entries. Settings opens the settings dialog.
  • Change: the page moved from Analytics › Askshelf to the Askshelf menu, at a new address. Update any bookmarks.

0.3.1

  • Fix: when the weekly email can’t be sent, the message now shows the reason WordPress gave, and the FAQ explains how to fix it.

0.3.0

  • New: Start free connects in one click, with no account. Buy, change or cancel a plan from Plans in the Askshelf top bar.
  • New: an ask-first start page with suggestions from your store, up to three things that need attention, and the full snapshot one click away.
  • New: “How I got this” under every answer shows each lookup, its dates and settings, and its caveats. Download CSV on answers with a chart or table.
  • New: optional custom queries for questions the built-in lookups can’t answer, shown to you before they run.
  • Answers now state the numbers and the change in the text, not only in the chart.
  • Deleting the plugin now disconnects the store from the service. A note on the Plugins screen says it doesn’t cancel a paid plan.

0.2.0

  • New: a free store snapshot on the Askshelf page and the WordPress Dashboard, with no questions used.
  • New: an optional weekly snapshot email.
  • New lookups: profit and margin (WooCommerce Cost of Goods Sold), sales by category, country, weekday, hour or payment method, new and returning customers, and stock that isn’t selling.

0.1.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
sections.description:
AI reports for WooCommerce: ask about sales, profit, low stock and customers in plain English. Plus a free sales dashboard and weekly email report.

🟡 WooCommerce AI analytics: ask your store, get the answer

Askshelf is an AI assistant for WooCommerce reports. Type a question such as “Which products sold best last month, compared with the month before?” or “What runs out in the next two weeks?” and get a short answer, a chart and the numbers behind it, in seconds. No reports to build, no filters to set, no spreadsheets to export.

Answers come from your own WooCommerce Analytics data, so they match the numbers you already trust: the same order statuses, refunds taken out, and your store’s time zone and currency.

There are no OpenAI or other AI API keys to find or pay for. Click Start free and ask your first question, with no account and no card.

👉 Try the live demo on a sample store in your browser, with nothing to install.

💬 Questions store owners ask Askshelf

🤖 How did sales this month compare with last month?
🤖 Which products sold best in October, and which fell the most?
🤖 What was my gross profit and margin last quarter, per product?
🤖 Which products run out in the next 14 days, and how much should I reorder?
🤖 Which stock hasn’t sold in 90 days, and how much money is tied up in it?
🤖 Which channels and campaigns brought orders this month?
🤖 How many customers came back for a second order?
🤖 How did the BLACKFRIDAY coupon do?
🤖 Which weekday and hour bring the most sales?

📈 WooCommerce sales reports in plain English

🟢 Sales totals and trends for any date range, compared with the period or year before
🟢 Best-selling products, and the ones that fell the most
🟢 Sales by category, country, weekday, hour of day and payment method
🟢 Today’s orders, read live
🟢 Every answer says which dates and settings it used

💰 WooCommerce profit and margin reports

Gross profit and margin, in total and per product, from WooCommerce’s built-in Cost of Goods Sold feature. Find your most profitable products and the ones with the thinnest margins, and see how profit changed against last month or last year.

📦 Low stock alerts and inventory reports

🟢 Products about to run out, worked out from stock levels and how fast each one sells
🟢 How much to reorder to cover the next few weeks
🟢 Dead stock: products that haven’t sold in 30, 60 or 90 days, and the money tied up in them
🟢 What all your inventory is worth, at cost or at selling price

👥 Customer, marketing and coupon reports

🟢 New and returning customers, repeat purchase rate and lifetime spend (as counts, never names)
🟢 Customers who stopped buying
🟢 Orders by channel, source and campaign, from WooCommerce order attribution
🟢 Coupon results: orders, discount given and sales

🆓 Free sales dashboard and weekly email report

These use no AI and no questions, and work before you connect:

🟢 A store snapshot on the Askshelf page and as a WordPress Dashboard widget: net sales, orders and average order for the last 7 days against the 7 before, today so far, gross profit, products that run out in the next 14 days, stock with no sales in 60 days, and what your stock is worth
🟢 An optional weekly email report of the snapshot every Monday morning, sent by your own site

🔍 See how every answer was worked out

🟢 “How I got this” under each answer lists every lookup, with its dates, settings and caveats
🟢 Show a chart, or download the rows as a CSV file
🟢 Questions and answers are saved in your own database, per user, and you can search them

🔒 Private and read-only

🟢 Askshelf only reads. It has no way to change your store
🟢 Customer names, emails, phone numbers and addresses are never read or sent to the AI, and Askshelf declines questions about individual people
🟢 You choose what Askshelf may read: orders, products and stock, order attribution and coupons
🟢 AI providers are limited to ones that do not store or train on your data

🌍 Works with your WooCommerce store

Works with HPOS (high-performance order storage) and the older posts storage, any currency and any theme. Nothing loads on your shop’s pages, so it can’t slow your store down.

🚀 Get started for free

The plugin is free, and every feature works on every plan. The free plan includes 10 AI questions a month, with no account and no card. Paid plans with more questions are on askshelf.in.

External services

Askshelf answers questions with an AI model through the Askshelf service, run by the plugin’s author (askshelf.in, hosted at uxyidbkbijinwziqwcjt.supabase.co). The store snapshot, the Dashboard widget and the weekly email are worked out on your own server and never use it. Nothing is sent until you click “Start free” or “Use my askshelf.in account”.

  • When you connect: your site’s address and the WordPress, WooCommerce and Askshelf version numbers. No account or email address is needed for Start free.
  • When you ask a question: your question and the earlier ones in the same conversation, the totals Askshelf looked up to answer it (such as product names, order counts and amounts, never customer names or contact details), and your store’s date, time zone, currency and language.

The service passes questions to an AI model through OpenRouter, using only providers that do not store or train on your data. It does not keep your questions, answers or store data. It keeps your site’s address and how many questions it asked each month, to apply your plan’s limit.

Paid plans are sold through Dodo Payments, which takes your email address and payment details on its own checkout page. The plugin never sees payment details.

  • Askshelf: terms, privacy policy
  • OpenRouter: terms, privacy policy
  • Dodo Payments: terms, privacy policy

Privacy

Askshelf adds no cookies and no tracking. See “External services” above for what is sent when you ask a question. Deleting the plugin disconnects the store and removes its settings and all saved conversations.
